summary: Focused auth-change regression: verified demo logins are removed and self-signup flow works end-to-end. Backend pytest 7/7 passed. Frontend Playwright covered Login page structure, tab toggle, no demo/quick-signin, signup validation (empty + short password), signup happy path, redirect to dashboard, logout, and re-login with created credentials — all passed.
passed_backend: POST /api/auth/login immediately after signup -> 200 with token
passed_frontend: /login renders with tab-login and tab-signup, NO 'Quick sign-in', NO OWNER/DISPATCH/FINANCE buttons, NO demo emails
login-email and login-password inputs start empty (no pre-fill)
Clicking tab-signup reveals signup-name, signup-email, signup-password, signup-role, signup-submit-btn
Empty signup submission blocked with error toast
Password < 6 chars blocked with error toast
Valid signup (role=owner) succeeds and redirects to dashboard (/)

Dashboard renders with 20 sidebar items (Executive Dashboard, Load Market Analysis, Dispatch Board, Loads, Trucks, Drivers, Compliance, Dispatch Queue, In-Transit, Weather & Roads, Fuel Stops, Telematics, Documents, Invoices, Profitability, Driver Scorecard, Truck Scorecard, Reports, AI Assistant, Settings)
sidebar-logout-btn logs user out back to /login
Re-login via login-email/login-password/login-submit-btn with created credentials succeeds and returns to dashboard
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still ~960 lines - previous iteration's split recommendation stands but non-blocking.
Signup accepts any email format via Pydantic default; consider EmailStr for stricter validation (currently accepts anything Pydantic allows).
Bcrypt hash on signup is synchronous inside async handler - acceptable for MVP volume; move to executor for high concurrency.
test_credentials: Created on-the-fly per test run using timestamp-suffixed emails, e.g. qa_<epoch_ms>@example.com / testpass123 / role varies. No pre-seeded accounts exist.
seed_data_creation: None. Auth suite creates its own user per run; no cleanup needed as emails are unique.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo users (owner@/dispatcher@/finance@dispatch.com) are permanently deleted. Every test must self-register via POST /api/auth/signup or the Create Account tab on /login. Use a unique email (timestamp suffix) to avoid 400 'Email exists'. Backend endpoints unchanged from iteration_5; only Login UI was rebuilt.
